digest.component_or_area: CLI core dispatcher and registry routing
propositions: Core CLI execution routes through a single validated registry-backed lazy handler resolver instead of parallel intercept/dispatch ladders and policy frozensets
Selected handlers are invoked through a closed typed adapter set {dispatcher, argv, argv_tracker, argv_tracker_root} with preserved original argv and exactly one S2 factory parse per command
Registry-derived mount/init policies (none/init_only/full) and route metadata match pre-cutover behavior including no-auto-mount and conditional cases

Confirmation, global output extraction, legacy JSON output shapes, token preservation after --, exit codes, and exception propagation maintain backward compatibility with existing CLI behavioral contracts
Bridge compatibility spellings (bridge-status, bridge-canonical) route through approved adapters while purge-bridge remains unknown per compatibility allowlist
Rollback capability is preserved via derived compatibility exports without changes to handler signatures, generated help, or persisted data
